$comment: MODULE_SPEC.md §4.2 deliberate exceptions for sdkwork-forum. Every entry MUST have a written reason and MUST sit in an explicitly named *_http_adapter module that is never the default.

allow.reason: Explicit split-deployment opt-in only. The default (and the only mode a deployment that configures nothing gets) is the in-process sdkwork-search provider SPI on the shared PostgreSQL. http is selected only by SDKWORK_FORUM_SEARCH_MODE=http, and the adapter validates SDKWORK_FORUM_SEARCH_URL plus SDKWORK_ACCESS_TOKEN at startup, so a split deployment cannot boot and then fail after forum state changed (MODULE_SPEC.md §4.2.3).
